accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II:

List-I (Member)
a. B. Pattabhi Sitaramayya
b. N. G. Ranga
c. Durgabai Deshmukh
d. M. Ananthasayanam Ayyangar

List-II (Role or association)
i. Peasant leader associated with the Kisan movement
ii. Founded the Andhra Mahila Sabha
iii. Chaired the House Committee
iv. Later became Deputy Speaker and Speaker of the Lok Sabha

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: B. Pattabhi Sitaramayya chaired the House Committee; N. G. Ranga was a peasant leader; Durgabai Deshmukh founded the Andhra Mahila Sabha; and M. Ananthasayanam Ayyangar later became Deputy Speaker and Speaker of the Lok Sabha.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure pair and eliminate codes containing a swapped role.

accepted.s: B. Pattabhi Sitaramayya was associated with which of the following combinations?
o: President of the Indian National Congress at Calcutta in 1911 and Chairman of the Union Power Committee
President of the Indian National Congress at Belgaum in 1924 and Chairman of the Advisory Committee
President of the Indian National Congress at Lahore in 1929 and Chairman of the Provincial Constitution Committee
President of the Indian National Congress at Jaipur in 1948 and Chairman of the House Committee
accepted.x: B. Pattabhi Sitaramayya chaired the House Committee and served as INC President at the Jaipur session in 1948.
accepted.tq: Use the person–office and person–session association directly.
accepted.sec: Members from the Andhra region - roles

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Some accounts identify P. Ananda Charlu as the first Telugu President of the Indian National Congress.
2. P. Ananda Charlu is associated with the year 1891 in this context.
3. B. Pattabhi Sitaramayya was INC President at Jaipur in 1948.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: some accounts cite P. Ananda Charlu in 1891, while B. Pattabhi Sitaramayya presided over the INC at Jaipur in 1948.
accepted.tq: Separate the alternative historical attribution from the clearly dated Congress presidency.

accepted.s:
Arrange the following events relating to the Andhra demand in chronological order:
A. Andhra was dropped from the Draft Constitution.
B. The Dhar Commission was named.
C. Jawaharlal Nehru accepted the Andhra demand in the Constituent Assembly.

Select the correct sequence.
accepted.x: Nehru accepted the Andhra demand on 27 November 1947; Andhra was dropped from the Draft Constitution on 21 February 1948; and the Dhar Commission was named on 17 June 1948.
accepted.tq: Fix the earliest and latest dates first, then place the intermediate event.
accepted.sec: Members from the Andhra region - roles

accepted.s:
With reference to the Andhra demand in the Constituent Assembly, consider the following statements:
1. Nehru accepted the demand on 27 November 1947.
2. Andhra was subsequently dropped from the Draft Constitution on 21 February 1948.
3. The Dhar Commission was named on 17 June 1948.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The Andhra demand was accepted by Nehru in the Assembly on 27 November 1947, omitted from the Draft Constitution on 21 February 1948, and followed by the naming of the Dhar Commission on 17 June 1948.
accepted.tq: Check each date independently before selecting the coded combination.

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
o: Election of Rajendra Prasad as First President — 24 January 1950
accepted.x: The National Song, Vande Mataram, was adopted on 24 January 1950. 27 December 1911 is associated with the first singing of Jana Gana Mana at the Calcutta INC session.
accepted.tq: Find the single date that belongs to a different national-symbol event.

accepted.s: The National Flag of India was adopted by the Constituent Assembly on
accepted.x: The Constituent Assembly adopted the National Flag on 22 July 1947.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the earlier flag-adoption date from the cluster of January 1950 decisions.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the evolution of the Indian National Flag:
1. Pingali Venkayya designed the tricolour in 1921.
2. He showed the design to Mahatma Gandhi at the AICC session at Bezwada.
3. Gandhi added the charkha to the design.
4. The Constituent Assembly replaced the charkha with the Ashoka Chakra.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements correctly describe the development of the national flag: Venkayya designed the tricolour in 1921, presented it at Bezwada, Gandhi added the charkha, and the Assembly replaced it with the Ashoka Chakra.
accepted.tq: Read the sequence as a design-development chain and test every stage.

accepted.s: Who among the following composed Vande Mataram, and in which work does it appear?
accepted.x: Vande Mataram was composed by Bankim Chandra Chatterji and appears in Anandamath.
accepted.tq: Use the author–work pairing and reject swapped authors or works.

accepted.s:
Arrange the following events associated with Vande Mataram in chronological order:
A. Vande Mataram was first sung by Rabindranath Tagore at an INC session.
B. Vande Mataram was composed.
C. Vande Mataram appeared in Anandamath.

Select the correct sequence.
accepted.x: Vande Mataram was composed in 1875, appeared in Anandamath in 1882, and was first sung by Tagore at the 1896 INC session.
accepted.tq: Arrange the events by their stated years: 1875, 1882 and 1896.

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements about Pingali Venkayya is correct?
o: He was born in 1948 at Bhatlapenumarru and was popularly known as Loknayak.
He was born in 1921 at Bezwada and was popularly known as Desabandhu.
He was born in 1876 at Bhatlapenumarru and was popularly known as Jhanda Venkayya.
He was born in 1891 at Jaipur and was popularly known as Andhra Kesari.
accepted.x: Pingali Venkayya was born in 1876 at Bhatlapenumarru and is popularly known as Jhanda Venkayya.
accepted.tq: Match the commemorated personality with the exact birthplace, year and popular title.

accepted.s: The national observance associated with 150 years of Vande Mataram was reported in
accepted.x: The national celebration of 150 years of Vande Mataram was reported in October 2025.
accepted.tq: Separate a recent anniversary observance from the original composition and adoption dates.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the reported 2026 amendment to the Prevention of Insults to National Honour Act:
1. It reportedly extends to the National Song the protection already given to the National Anthem.
2. The report concerning this amendment was dated 23 August 2026.
3. The amendment concerns the design of the National Flag by Pingali Venkayya.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The reported amendment extends the protection given to the National Anthem to the National Song, and the report was dated 23 August 2026. It does not concern the design of the National Flag.
accepted.tq: Identify the correct subject and date while rejecting a neighbouring national-symbol fact.

accepted.s: The Munshi–Ayyangar formula is recalled in connection with Hindi Diwas because it was adopted on
accepted.x: The Munshi–Ayyangar formula was adopted on 14 September 1949, a date recalled in connection with Hindi Diwas.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the language-related constitutional date from dates connected with Andhra and national symbols.

accepted.s: Which one of the following best captures the principal criticism and counter-view concerning the Constituent Assembly?
o: It was criticised because it had no Congress members, although it represented only one political opinion.
It was criticised solely for adopting national symbols before discussing fundamental rights.
It was universally regarded as fully representative and excluded all dissenting views.
It was criticised for representativeness and Congress dominance, but it also included a broad range of views.
accepted.x: The Constituent Assembly faced criticism concerning its representativeness and Congress dominance, while its broad inclusion of different views formed an important counter-consideration.
accepted.tq: Balance the criticism with the qualifying counter-view rather than choosing an absolute claim.
